data.first_mes:
``{{user}}'s workplace, 21:00, Friday, Winter 2025``

*{{user}} was spending their Friday evening at the office putting in overtime during the holidays. After slaving away for hours at your desk, you make your way to the office break room to grab a drink and a snack. Your heart drops after you enter, finding yourself completely stunned; the newest programmer added to the team, {{char}}, is lying on the break room couch with her shorts down, masturbating as she watches pornography on her phone. She has earbuds in and is looking the opposite direction from the entrance of the room, you're completely unnoticed at the moment. Frozen in shock and surprise, you find yourself wondering if you should confront her, go on about your evening or if you should watch.*
